summary: Iter 11 validated the mobile paywall build (Capacitor + RevenueCat + Free-tier gate). BACKEND: All 42 pytest tests PASS (3 harmless skips). Free-tier gate correctly returns HTTP 402 with detail.code='free_tier_limit_reached' on the 4th round; premium sync flips is_premium and grants all catalog items; downgrade re-applies the gate; /premium/status returns the full documented shape (entitlement_id='kite_premium', free_rounds_per_day=3, rounds_remaining_today=3 for fresh user). FRONTEND (web preview): nav-premium Sparkles icon renders with badge '3' for new user, opens paywall-dialog on click, amber paywall-web-notice explicitly names 'App Store or Google Play', restore-btn is DISABLED on web, purchase-btn is HIDDEN on web (as expected — Capacitor.isNativePlatform()===false), all 4 benefit rows render (Unlimited daily rounds / All sky themes / Every kite & companion / First access to future features). After 3 rounds, /play shows free-tier-gate with upgrade + back buttons; nav-premium badge decrements to '0'. No blocking console errors — a few 401s on /premium/status fire pre-login (PremiumContext boots before auth) which is cosmetic and expected. No regressions in Stripe shop, XP curve, or leaderboard.

issues: Fires GET /api/premium/status while unauthenticated on first paint, producing 2x 401 console errors before login. Cosmetic only — auto-recovers post-login. Consider gating the boot fetch on presence of auth cookie / user context.

action_items: (NON-BLOCKING, cosmetic) Gate PremiumContext initial /api/premium/status fetch on presence of authenticated user so 2x 401 console errors don't fire pre-login. Boot fetch currently runs unconditionally on app mount.

(FUTURE — when store credentials arrive) Add X-RevenueCat-Signature verification in /api/premium/webhook (currently accepts anything — noted in code comment as TODO). Also enable RevenueCat SDK secret key env var + iOS/Android build. Not testable now.
critical_code_review_comments: Free-tier gate correctly applied ONLY at /api/questions entry (server.py L560-573); increment happens after successful bag composition (L640-648) with UTC-midnight rollover via _today_utc_str() + last_round_date comparison — clean design, no double-counting on error paths.
_resolve_premium_state (L697) correctly handles expiry: if premium_expires_at is in the past it returns is_premium=false without needing an admin sweep — server enforces truth on every request.
sync_premium (L737) idempotently grants all catalog items via $addToSet with $each, preventing owned-list dupes. Good.
PremiumContext boots /api/premium/status on mount unconditionally, producing 401 console noise pre-login (see design_issues). Not a functional bug — just a cosmetic action-item.
Paywall.jsx correctly hides purchase-btn when servicesAvailable=false (verified in DOM: purchase-btn present=false). This matches the E1 spec for web preview.

Backend test fixture (client) auto-marks the session user premium via /premium/sync before running gameplay tests — this is the correct isolation strategy so free-tier gate doesn't leak into regressions.
(CARRY-OVER from iter 9-10, not this iter) K8s ingress still injects wildcard CORS headers on the public URL. Not in scope.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 11 mobile-paywall feature is production-ready for web preview. Backend has 42 passing pytest tests including 4 new premium tests (free_tier_gate_blocks_after_daily_cap / premium_sync_grants_unlimited_rounds / premium_status_shape / premium_downgrade_via_sync). Frontend paywall correctly renders 'unavailable on web' state — nav-premium badge, paywall-dialog, paywall-web-notice, paywall-restore-btn (disabled), paywall-purchase-btn (hidden), all 4 benefits, free-tier-gate on /play, badge decrement. Only cosmetic issue: PremiumContext boot fetches /api/premium/status before auth is established → 2x 401 console errors on first paint. Not a functional bug. When iOS/Android store credentials arrive, add RevenueCat webhook signature verification and re-test on native (currently untestable — Capacitor.isNativePlatform()===false in browser).
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Cosmetic 401 console noise root-caused: PremiumContext (/app/frontend/src/contexts/PremiumContext.jsx) calls GET /api/premium/status on mount without checking whether an auth session cookie exists yet. On first paint before login, this fails with 401. Mitigation: guard the boot fetch behind the user-context-loaded state (e.g., only fetch when useAuth().user is truthy). Zero user-visible impact.
